exposure: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with dilation and curettage (D&C)
cohort: 91 patients diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancies (CSP) between 2019 and 2021.
finding: UAE combined with D&C resulted in decreased menstrual blood volume and longer menstrual recovery time compared to D&C alone, but no significant difference in overall fertility outcomes (pregnancy and birth rates) was observed.
